name: eventhub-ionic
description: Version Ionic indépendante de EventHub Reservation Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,IONIC -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix Frontend start"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check Frontend/src Backend/src scripts README.md docs/*.md
